Notes.Text:
This update for xorg-x11-server fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-109091: X.Org Server EDID DS_RANGES Out-Of-Bounds Write (bsc#1285086).
- CVE-2026-109092: X.Org Server XvShmPutImage Shared-Memory Bounds Overflow (bsc#1285087).
- CVE-2026-109093: X.Org Server XTestFakeInput Valuator Stack Out-Of-Bounds Write (bsc#1285088).
- CVE-2026-109094: X.Org Server XRes QueryResourceBytes Swap Path Size Overflow (bsc#1285089).
- CVE-2026-109095: X.Org Server glamor Xv Image Size Integer Overflow (bsc#1285090).
- CVE-2026-109096: X.Org Server XvPutImage Negative Image Size Length Bypass (bsc#1285091).
- CVE-2026-109903: X.Org Server XvQueryImageAttributes Negative Size Reply (bsc#1285093).
- CVE-2026-109904: X.Org Server XRes QueryClientIds Request Size Overflow (bsc#1285094).
